papers.title: Mitigating variance shrinkage in multi-task galaxy property inference from imaging data via statistical manifold alignment
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, accepted by A&A
papers.summary: Vision transformer with multi-scale MMD loss infers photometric redshifts and stellar population properties from HSC imaging, reducing variance shrinkage while matching DESI distributions.

papers.title: Self-Organizing Maps for the Exploration and Classification of X-Ray Sources in the Chandra Source Catalog
papers.comment: 34 pages, 19 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in ApJ
papers.summary: Self-organizing maps project Chandra source spectral and variability features, revealing class structure and classifying unlabeled X-ray detections with ~53% coverage.

papers.title: Machine-Learning Reconstruction of Intergalactic Medium Column-Density Maps from Observed Ly$\alpha$ Emission Cubes
papers.comment: 35 pages, 20 figures. Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal (ApJ)
papers.summary: A CNN trained on IllustrisTNG and radiative-transfer simulations reconstructs intergalactic medium column-density maps from noisy KCWI Lyα emission cubes, recovering filamentary structures.

papers.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) B: Discovery pipeline overview
papers.comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, submitted to A&A. Paper intended for the A&A Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release"
papers.summary: The multi-stage Euclid DR1 lens search combines neural-network classification of 68 million objects with citizen science and expert grading, reaching 0.73 completeness for grade-A lenses.

papers.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) A: Strong lens catalogue overview
papers.comment: 28 pages. Submitted to A&A as part of the Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release"
authors: Euclid Collaboration: N. E. P. Lines
papers.summary: Euclid DR1 yields 15,072 high-confidence strong lens candidates found by fusing five machine-learning model scores with citizen-scientist and expert visual classification over 2000 deg2.

papers.title: Identification of extragalactic radio sources in the VISTA survey of the Magellanic Clouds using an unsupervised machine learning algorithm
papers.summary: t-SNE clustering of optical-to-radio photometry separates AGN, galaxies, blazars, dusty objects and stars among ASKAP/VMC sources in the Magellanic Clouds.
